description: Dynamics provides the concepts and tools to describe and understand complicated long-term behaviour in systems that evolve over time. This course aims to develop these ideas in a gradual progression toward ever greater complexity, with proofs. Both topological and statistical points of view are developed. Major topics: Linear maps, recurrence and equidistribution of simple maps, conservative systems, systems with complicated orbit structure, entropy and chaos.
